before.title: Korrosionsverhalten von Metallen beurteilen
before.description: Die lernende Person kann Abweichungen vom erwarteten Korrosionsverhalten erklären und daraus unterschiedliche Verwendungsmöglichkeiten von Metallen und Legierungen ableiten.
before.descriptionEn: The learner can explain deviations from expected corrosion behavior and derive different uses of metals and alloys.

skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.sourceContext: Joint Berlin-Brandenburg RLP Chemie2022, printed/physical26 and53-55. P26 defines common GK content and additional LK column. P53 common corrosion includes local cells, oxygen/acid corrosion and sacrificial protection; p54 actual corrosion investigation is separate. P55 offers rust/aluminium contexts.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.sourceLimit: The full c95 goal/P is an explicit SkillPilot extension: explain observed departure from simple potential ranking through dense passive films/porous rust and use material/phase/environment data to judge aluminium and alloys, with chloride/crevice/repassivation limits. This is not official exact whole-source credit, a practical investigation, a nanomaterial/coating-production duty or proof of a learner-selected context.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.wholeAcquisitionScope: Both original DE/EN cases and all four current expectations remain: thermodynamic tendency vs rate; protective film vs porous rust; conditional environment-based use judgment; alloy/chloride/data limits. Figures and costs are synthetic supplied model conditions, not current product evidence.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.existingTargetConsequence: Retain the already authored direct c95 target in both listed GK/LK raw views. The corrected94a→642d prerequisite must remain; c95 is not restored as an unrelated prerequisite merely to carry jurisdiction.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.compilerScopeSemantics: Proposed supported override adds only this jurisdiction as own scope input. Current GK/LK tags and unchanged actual listed views bound intended placement; metadata is no stage/course enforcement field and views remain CrossStage. Retained raw applicability is an earlier field, not the observed after-state. Final actual fixed-point/filter results require separate rerun and binding.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.ownerPolicyBoundary: Include already authored applicable Chemistry topics before a later topic-choice flow; preserve source optionality and no persisted individual choice.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.noOtherJurisdictionOverride: Only BB and BE are proposed. No other derived applicability difference or other excluded topic is a scope authorization.
